claude.sample_unit: real counseling dialogue contexts (clinical expert evaluation; 490 context-response pairs rated by 8 experts)

links.outcome: Expert-rated empathic attunement and safety of domain-fine-tuned chatbot versus base model, with counseling experts involved
links.effect: YuanChat-Huozi3.5 empathic attunement 1.279 vs 0.327 for base Huozi3.5 (mean difference 0.952, 95% CI 0.746-1.152); safety rating close to counselors (difference 0.002).
links.quote: From descriptive results ( Table 9 ), compared with Huozi3.5, YuanChat-Huozi3.5 received higher empathic attunement ratings (1.279 vs 0.327; mean difference 0.952, 95% CI 0.746-1.152) and supportive appropriateness ratings (1.389 vs 1.070; mean difference 0.320, 95% CI 0.134-0.502).

links.outcome: Evaluation of generative AI communication for empathy and appropriateness, and effect of fine-tuning and E-URIAL on empathy scores
links.effect: Fine-tuning raised YuanChat-Huozi3.5 EES from 0.57 to 0.68 and EIS from 0.54 to 0.59; E-URIAL k=3 raised EIS to 0.69 and EES to 0.79.
links.quote: Fine-tuning increased YuanChat-Huozi3.5's empathic expression score from 0.57 to 0.68; empathy identification score increased from 0.54 to 0.59.

links.outcome: Interrater reliability of expert annotations used as reference standard
links.effect: Mean pairwise Cohen kappa 0.5857 for ESC stages, 0.4219 for counseling techniques, 0.5887 for empathy effect; overall IRR 0.5321 (moderate agreement).
links.quote: The mean pairwise κ was 0.5857 for the ESC stages, 0.4219 for counseling techniques, and 0.5887 for empathy effect, indicating moderate agreement.

links.outcome: Effect of retrieval-augmented exemplar grounding (E-URIAL) on empathic response quality
links.effect: Dynamic retrieval ablation: removing retrieval dropped EIS by 0.09, EES by 0.11, empathy by 0.16; E-URIAL k=3 raised GPT-4 EIS from 0.45 to 0.57 and EES from 0.54 to 0.65.
links.quote: Replacing dynamic retrieval with static exemplars caused the most extreme performance drop across all metrics (eg, EES decreased by 0.11).

unlisted_practices: Fine-tuning LLMs on real-world counseling data with structured emotional support labels to improve empathic responding
Inference-time retrieval of labeled counselor exemplars with predicted emotion and strategy labels (E-URIAL)
Dual-model label-consistency filtering and constrained rewriting to build training data

links.outcome: comparison with counselors and other models
links.effect: YuanChat-Huozi3.5 vs counselor: +0.148, +0.079, +0.039, +0.002; Holm-adjusted P≥.29; other models had significant gaps.
links.quote: YuanChat-Huozi3.5 was the only model for which the comparisons with counselor responses did not reach statistical significance in any of the 4 dimensions; the remaining models all exhibited significant gaps compared to counselors in various dimensions.

links.outcome: expert review of fine-tuning data quality
links.effect: Expert review of 216 turns: contextual authenticity 95.37%, empathic appropriateness 59.26%, semantic naturalness 77.31%, total acceptance 71.99%.
links.quote: With a total score of ≥12 as the threshold for acceptance, the overall acceptance rate was 71.99%.

links.effect: Safety/professional boundaries: Huozi3.5 1.445 vs counselor 1.689 (−0.245, P<.001); YuanChat-Huozi3.5 1.691 (+0.002, P=.87).
links.quote: GPT-4 received lower ratings for empathic attunement and safety and professional boundary adherence; GLM4-9B-Chat received lower ratings for supportive appropriateness, perceived helpfulness, and safety and professional boundary adherence; YuanChat-GLM4-9B received lower ratings for safety and professional boundary adherence; and CharacterGLM received higher empathic attunement ratings than the counselor responses.

unlisted_practices: Fine-tuning LLMs on real-world counseling dialogue data for emotional support
Inference-time retrieval-augmented prompting with predicted emotion and counseling strategy labels
Dynamic retrieval of semantically similar human-annotated counselor exemplars

links.outcome: Expert-rated empathic attunement, supportive strategy appropriateness, and safety and boundary adherence
links.effect: Compared to counselors, GPT-4 scored lower on empathic attunement (-0.421) and safety (-0.166); GLM-4-9B-Chat scored lower on supportive strategy (-0.400), helpfulness (-0.366), and safety (-0.263); and YuanChat-GLM4-9B scored lower on safety (-0.091; all Holm-adjusted P<.001).
links.quote: GPT-4 received lower ratings for empathic attunement and safety and professional boundary adherence; GLM4-9B-Chat received lower ratings for supportive appropriateness, perceived helpfulness, and safety and professional boundary adherence; YuanChat-GLM4-9B received lower ratings for safety and professional boundary adherence; and CharacterGLM received higher empathic attunement ratings than the counselor responses.

unlisted_practices: Fine-tuning large language models on counseling dialogue datasets annotated with emotional support stages and techniques
Retrieval-augmented in-context alignment (E-URIAL) using predicted emotion and strategy labels with dynamically retrieved labeled counselor exemplars
